about.headline:
Made with intention,
stitched with love
body: Every piece in our collection starts with a single strand of yarn and a hook. We source only the finest cotton, wool, and bamboo blends — soft enough for babies, durable enough for everyday use.
Each item is made to order, which means it's crafted fresh just for you. No mass production, no shortcuts — only genuine handmade work delivered with care.

products.name: Daisy Book Sleeve
products.shortDescription: Keep your favourite reads cozy and protected with our handmade crochet daisy book sleeve
products.description: A cute, handmade crochet book sleeve featuring a dreamy blue-and-white daisy design. Carefully crocheted with soft yarn, it’s perfect for keeping your books protected from scratches, dust and minor bumps while adding a little personality to your reading routine
products.Washable: Hand wash, lay flat to dry

products.name: Cloud Baby Blanket
products.shortDescription: Ultra-soft stitch-pattern baby blanket in pastel hues
products.description: Wrap your little one in pure warmth with our Cloud Stitch Baby Blanket. Worked in a luxuriously soft cloud-stitch pattern, this blanket is breathable, stretchy, and gentle on newborn skin. Available in a range of pastel and neutral tones to match any nursery aesthetic. Each blanket is blocked and finished with a neat border.

products.name: Slouchy Ribbed Beanie
products.shortDescription: Stretchy ribbed beanie with oversized slouch — one size fits all
products.description: A wardrobe staple for cooler days. Our Slouchy Ribbed Beanie is worked in a 3×3 rib pattern that gives it the perfect amount of stretch and structure. The generous slouch sits comfortably without being too floppy. Available in over a dozen yarn colours — earthy neutrals, moody jewel tones, and everything in between.

products.name: Sunflower Market Bag
products.shortDescription: Open-weave cotton tote perfect for the farmers market
products.description: Stylish and sustainable — our Sunflower Market Bag features a bold open-weave body in natural cotton with a sunflower motif patch crocheted at the base. Strong double handles are reinforced at the join. It expands to hold a full grocery run and folds flat when empty. The perfect everyday carry for eco-conscious shoppers.

products.name: Boho Coaster Set
products.shortDescription: Mandala-pattern cotton coasters — set of 4 mixed colours
products.description: Add a boho touch to your coffee table with our handmade mandala coasters. Each set of four coasters features the same intricate pattern worked in complementary yarn colours. Thick enough to protect surfaces, beautiful enough to be left out as décor. Makes a wonderful housewarming gift paired with candles or mugs.

products.name: Chunky Infinity Scarf
products.shortDescription: Cosy oversized loop scarf in chunky arm-weight yarn
products.description: A quick double-wrap around your neck and you're ready for the cold. Our Chunky Infinity Scarf is worked in a simple but stunning basketweave stitch using super-chunky arm-weight yarn, giving it incredible warmth and texture. The loop format means no ends to tuck in and no risk of it falling off.

products.name: Flower Headband
products.shortDescription: Stretchy ear-warmer headband with a crocheted flower accent
products.description: Keep your ears toasty without messing up your hair. This stretchy ribbed headband fits comfortably and securely, topped with a hand-crocheted flower in a contrasting colour. Great for workouts, school runs, or just cosy days at home.

products.name: Baby Booties Pair
products.shortDescription: Soft-soled crocheted booties for newborns to 6 months
products.description: Tiny, soft, and utterly adorable — our Baby Booties come in newborn and 0–6 month sizes. Each pair is lovingly crocheted in smooth DK cotton with a non-slip textured sole and a sweet button or bow closure at the ankle. They arrive gift-packaged in tissue paper and twine, ready to delight at a baby shower.
